jobs.title: Product Support Manager, Google Pay India
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer\-facing role.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience leading end\-to\-end programs from concept to deployment in fast\-paced, ambiguous, or startup\-like environments.
* Deep experience supporting, troubleshooting, and driving solutions for UPI\-based platforms and products within the Financial Services or Fintech industry.
* Extensive experience in business process mapping and implementing innovative solutions using AI and automation to serve millions of users efficiently while maintaining high\-quality standards.
* Proven track record of resolving complex, multi\-party escalations in high\-stakes environments.
* Ability to lead and influence diverse cross\-functional teams and external partners to drive a cohesive support strategy.

**About the job**
-----------------


gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in\-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross\-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner. Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.  

  

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and evolve the user support experience strategy for Google Pay India, understanding all aspects of customer support.
* Partner across cross\-functional groups (Engineering, Product Management, UX, Legal) and external partners to lead support readiness and program manage product launches ensuring and operational expertise.
* Transform Voice of the User (VoU) data, Top User Issues (TUIs), and market\-specific feedback into strategic insights; lead programs for user experience improvements and ensure feedback loops inform product strategy for market users.
* Develop and implement scalable service models, workflows, and process improvements using AI, internal tools and data to increase efficiency, remove operational friction, and resolve issues.
* Oversee the feedback ecosystem and quality audits, and serve as a key point of escalation.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. --------------------

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Manager, Unified Auth
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Unified Authorization is responsible for securing customer and corporate communication across all of Amazon. Whether it's the retail website, Alexa, Prime Video, or Kindle, we ensure actors are authenticated and authorized to take the requested action. Every aspect of Amazon's business interacts with our systems, including enabling the next generation of retail services on AWS infrastructure. As a global security provider, we're at the intersection of resiliency, availability, and the need to move at agile internet speed.  

  

You are an experienced development leader to lead a team of software development engineers. You work closely with product management and other business partners to define strategy and requirements, and lead development teams from concept through delivery and subsequent operation. You have regular communication with senior management on status, risks and product strategy. You have excellent listening, writing skills and very strong technical competency. You're a thought leader, but you don't just know how to solve the problem, you prove it by leading team to build the solution. Last but not the least; you have a high bar for code quality and passion for design and architecture.  

  

As the ideal candidate you will be experienced in leading a team of software development engineers and have a proven track record of shipping complex software solutions through an agile methodology. You will have the ability to dive deep into the understanding of problems in order to help your team make the right technical decisions for the product and the business. You will have a proven track record of working across organizational lines. You will also be a strong communicator and will have proven abilities in managing through ambiguous situations.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Senior Manager, Software Development, you will lead multiple engineering teams responsible for building and operating critical authorization services that protect customer and corporate resources across Amazon. You will define long\-term technical and organizational strategy, drive execution of large\-scale initiatives, and ensure the delivery of highly available, secure, and scalable systems that operate at Amazon scale.  

  

You will partner closely with Product Management, Security, AWS, and business leaders across Amazon to define roadmaps, align investments, and deliver solutions that simplify secure access for millions of users, services, devices, and emerging AI\-powered applications. You will influence technical direction across organizational boundaries, balancing innovation, operational excellence, and customer trust.  

  

You will be responsible for developing engineering leaders and building high\-performing teams by hiring exceptional talent, setting a high bar for technical excellence, and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning. You will mentor managers and senior engineers, helping them grow their technical depth, leadership capabilities, and business impact.  

  

You will establish mechanisms to ensure operational excellence, resiliency, security, and compliance for mission\-critical services. You will regularly review architecture, software quality, and operational metrics, driving improvements that enhance reliability, availability, and developer productivity.
  

  

Successful candidates will demonstrate strong business judgment, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to lead through ambiguity. They will combine strategic thinking with technical depth, diving deep when necessary while maintaining focus on long\-term organizational outcomes. They will have a proven track record of delivering complex distributed systems, influencing senior stakeholders, and leading organizations through periods of growth and transformation.  

  

About the team  

Unified Auth secures every service transaction within Amazon SDO’s service\-oriented architecture by authenticating services, authorizing API access, and enforcing least\-privilege access to business data such as Cart, Orders, Customer Identity, and Employee Information. Classified as a Maximally Secure Application, it governs access across all Amazon services. A single customer interaction (e.g., checkout) spans tens to hundreds of inter\-service calls that must be secured and observed. Stores, Alexa, Prime Video, Ads, Selling Partners, Payments, Fulfillment, and internal systems rely on Unified Auth to meet evolving security and privacy standards, including DMA, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type II.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10\+ years of engineering experience
* 5\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 10\+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience partnering with product and program management teams
* Experience designing and developing large scale, high\-traffic applications

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**About The Job**
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 This role has a critical impact on the Company's ability to meet changing existing and meeting new regulatory requirements. Strategic verticals like Play Marketplace and businesses like Cloud are dependent on Anti\-Financial Compliance (AFC) product capabilities to stay compliant.
   

  

 You will be leading the building of the capabilities for Anti\-Financial Compliance Platform including Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), Screenings and Regulatory reporting. You will partner with first\-party integrators such as Cloud or Play to understand their regulatory compliance needs, build product strategy and roadmap. You will define the review tools that are used by our analysts and also explore how AI/ML can be leveraged to improve operational efficiency and partner with financial compliance investigators, engineers, data scientists, program managers, cross\-functional stakeholders through the planning, design, development, testing, launch, and post\-launch.
   

  

 Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own one of more areas within Payments Anti\-Financial Crimes platform, Anti Money Laundering, Screenings or Regulatory reporting.
* Work with Payments Compliance business stakeholders to understand, measure, and prioritize individual needs aimed at reducing regulatory, brand and other payments compliance risks.
* Work with First\-Party (1P) integrators such as Cloud or Play to understand their regulatory needs, define and launch products or solutions to enable their business growth.

**About Us**
**Location \- Hyderabad, India**
**Department \- Product R\&D**
**Level \- Team Leader/ Professional**

**Salary \- this will be discussed at the next stage of the process, if you do have any questions, please feel free to reach out!**
 Join our dynamic Agile development team as a Technical Product Owner, where you will play a pivotal role in the Software Development Lifecycle, ensuring the timely delivery of innovative products. We are seeking a detail\-oriented individual who is passionate about professional advancement, contributing to Sprint backlog development to drive the achievement of Product team goals.
   

  

 As a Technical Product Owner, you will play a critical role in driving the development and success of our products. You will work closely with the Product Manager and cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, prioritise features, and ensure the timely delivery of high\-quality products. This is an excellent opportunity for an aspiring Product Owner to gain valuable experience in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Impact on Strategy**
* Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with stakeholders, and internal teams to gather and document product requirements, ensuring a clear understanding of the desired outcomes.
* Communication and Coordination: Facilitate effective communication between the development team, and stakeholders. Act as a liaison to clarify requirements, answer questions, and address concerns.
* User Story Development: Assist in breaking down high\-level requirements into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria, ensuring that the development team understands what needs to be built.
* Sprint Review and Retrospective: Contribute to sprint review sessions to ensure that the product meets customer expectations. Participate in retrospectives to identify areas for improvement and implement lessons learned.
* Product Documentation: Assist in creating and maintaining product documentation, including user manuals, release notes, and feature descriptions, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
* Progress Reporting: Report on the progress of the development team to ensure any impacts are communicated and understood early to enable the team to ‘fail\-fast’.


**Leadership and Management**
* Sprint Planning: Participate in sprint planning sessions, assisting the Product Manager in determining the scope of work for each sprint and establishing achievable goals.
* Backlog Management: Assist in maintaining and prioritizing the product backlog, ensuring that user stories and tasks are well\-defined, estimated, and prioritized based on business value and customer needs.


 Any other duties that may be required by your Manager or the Company, providing you have been adequately trained to execute them. These duties may be required from time to time or on a permanent basis.
   

  

**Skills And Experience**
* 3\-5 years of experience in a product\-related role, such as Product Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar. Experience in Agile methodologies is preferred.
* Proven ability to identify and resolve problems effectively, displaying a proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.
* Experience with data analytics and metrics tracking desirable.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong Analytical Skills: Ability to analyse complex problems, break them down into smaller components, and propose effective solutions.
* Excellent Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey ideas and requirements clearly and effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative Nature: Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented, cross\-functional environment, building relationships and fostering collaboration.
* Attention to Detail: Strong organisational skills with a keen eye for detail, ensuring that requirements and deliverables are accurately documented and tracked.
* Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, and able to quickly adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
* Passion for Technology: Enthusiasm for emerging technologies, software development processes, and the ability to stay updated with the latest industry trends.
* Self\-Motivated: A proactive individual who takes ownership of tasks and demonstrates the drive to learn, grow, and take on additional responsibilities.


**About Ideagen**
 Ideagen is the invisible force behind many things we rely on every day \- from keeping airplanes soaring in the sky, to ensuring the food on our tables is safe, to helping doctors and nurses care for the sick. So, when you think of Ideagen, think of it as the silent teammate that's always working behind the scenes to help those people who make our lives safer and better. Everyday millions of people are kept safe using Ideagen software. We have offices all over the world including America, Australia, Malaysia and India with people doing lots of different and exciting jobs.
   

  

**What is next?**
 If your application meets the requirements for this role, our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch to guide you through the next steps.
   

  

 To ensure a flexible and inclusive process, please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments by contacting us at recruitment@ideagen.com. All matters will be treated with strict confidence.
   

  

 At Ideagen, we value the importance of work\-life balance and welcome candidates seeking flexible or part\-time working arrangements. If this is something you are interested in, please let us know during the application process.
   

  

 Enhance your career and make the world a safer place!

**Job Description**
***About Sanofi***
 We’re an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.
   

  

**About The Job**
 At Sanofi, we’re committed to providing the next\-gen healthcare that patients and customers need. The Digital Launch \& Market Product team ( LMP) is one of the key vertical towers within Digital R\&D, includes product line teams to serve global regulatory Affairs ( GRA),
 **Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PSPV)** 
 , R\&D CMO/Medical etc. domains. We focus on delivery of innovative digital products to support and accelerate product launches, accelerating cycle times to bring medicines to patients faster while improving operational efficiency and ensure regulatory compliance.
   

  

 This position operates within Sanofi Digital R\&D \- Digital Launch \& Market Product (LMP) \- Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PSPV) Product Line whose mission is to help improve Patient Safety with AI and automation enabled Digital Solutions.
   

  

 As
 **Digital Product Owner** 
 , you will be accountable to:
 ***Define \- strategy and roadmap** 
 ,
 **Drive \- delivery and management, Measure \- value and impact***
**of the Digital Product.**
**Main Responsibilities –**
* Product Vision
+ Set and communicate \- the vision for the product, working closely with Digital and Business Leadership and key stakeholders.
+ Ensure vision is aligned with Company strategic direction.
+ Manage strong relationships and partnerships with Digital R\&D verticals and across Business functions, that interact with Portfolio management and decision\-making.
+ Stay current in industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in Product management.
+ Identify opportunities for process improvement using AI and automation.
+ Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the product team

* Product Delivery
+ Define clear and actionable goals to deliver incremental value.
+ Lead delivery of Product from conception, MVP(minimum viable product) through continuous improvements.
+ Define, implement and lead Governance around the Digital Product \- to ensure best practices are followed, prioritizations aligned, value realized, risks managed.
+ Ensure collaboration with the architecture, Digital Data and AI, and digital R\&D Data Product and Platform teams
+ Ensure Agile framework and methodologies are followed, to deliver incremental value.
+ Manage backlog prioritization, balancing short\-term deliverables with long\-term goals and breakthrough ideas.
+ Champion modern AI tooling to accelerate design, testing, and iteration.

* Product Value
+ Ensure AI\-driven insights, automated workflows are integrated in the product and aligns with user journey – data, process, people.
+ Drive user adoption by delivering intuitive, user\-centric solutions. Gathering regular feedback, monitoring usage metrics, user satisfaction.
+ Ensure each sprint delivers measurable improvements to cycle times, internal productivity, quality and compliance, user experience.
+ Deliver Continuous improvement in changing digital landscape, regulatory requirements and business strategy.
+ Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases


**About You**
**Education \& Experience:**
* 10\+ IT industry experience with 5\+ years of experience working in Digital Product delivery and leadership as a product owner or product manager
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or STEM related field. Master degree is preferred.
* Experience in pharmaceutical industry with knowledge of pharmaceutical Drug lifecycle, R\&D value chain.
* Functional and technical expertise in the Pharmacovigilance ( PV) domain is highly desirable.
* Experience of software development in a GxP regulated environment is a strong plus.


**Key Skills**
* Expertise in leading cross\-functional teams to create Digital Strategies and Implementation roadmaps. Distinctive focus on solution objectives and application of product methodologies.
* Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical designs and solutions, with a strong business and technical acumen
* Experienced in complex solution implementation \& delivery in agile.
* Demonstrated track record of designing, developing, and delivering transformative digital products – particularly in the AI space is a strong plus.
* Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases
* Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases
* Strong technical/functional background, with the ability to understand and communicate complex functional/technical concepts.
* Solid knowledge and experience of Lean \& Agile practices, UX/UI and Application Design \& Integration

jobs.title: Associate Director – Human Capital (Infrastructure and Systems)
jobs.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary leader who is passionate about driving technological innovation within the HC domain to join our Human Capital (Infrastructure and Systems) team in Hyderabad, India. The Human Capital (HC) Infra \& Systems team at D. E. Shaw designs, maintains, and advances technology for all HC functions. This global team partners with Human Capital, Technology, Analytics, and Global Products, translating business goals into scalable, user\-focused solutions. They manage the full lifecycle of HC systems, from gathering requirements and creating infrastructure to enhancing systems, testing, and optimizing post\-launch. Team members work across functions to address evolving needs, close system gaps, and improve user experience and efficiency. They coordinate multiple projects to ensure connectivity across HC disciplines. As subject matter experts and technology enablers, they keep systems resilient, future\-ready, and aligned with D. E. Shaw’s strategy. The team culture emphasizes innovation, partnership, and excellence in service, enabling the firm to attract and develop top talent globally.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 In this role, you will partner with developers and collaborate with key stakeholders both locally and globally to design and implement a strategic vision for robust HC systems infrastructure, supporting all facets of the HC lifecycle — from hiring to separation. Serving as a strategic liaison between HC, Technology, Analytics, and the Global Products team, you will help ensure aligned and collaborative outcomes. A crucial aspect of the position involves engaging deeply with stakeholders to understand their technological needs, meticulously documenting requirements, and translating these into detailed functional specifications and comprehensive process drafts. Additionally, you will oversee cross\-team collaboration, ensuring seamless communication between specialized teams within HC to drive integrated project planning and execution.
   

  

 You will work closely with senior leadership to translate strategic business goals into clear and executable technology initiatives. This includes conducting thorough assessments of the current HC tech infrastructure, identifying gaps, and developing strategic roadmaps for transitioning to future\-state solutions. Furthermore, you will oversee the creation and execution of test cases and scenarios, manage the UAT process, and ensure system alignment with user requirements, specifications, and quality standards. As part of your ongoing responsibilities, you will ensure that all systems are optimized to support the organization’s strategic goals, enhance user experience, and drive operational efficiency. Finally, you will lead and mentor a team of HC technology professionals, promoting a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and excellence in service delivery.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 We are seeking a visionary leader who is passionate about driving technological innovation within the HC domain.
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* Proven Experience: A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience in product or services firms with a focus on Human Capital functions
* Deep HR Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of HR systems and infrastructure, with proven experience in addressing both technological and operational challenges in a dynamic environment
* Analytical Expertise with Technical Acumen: Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to distill complex business requirements into actionable technology initiatives
* Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills that enable clear and effective engagement with senior leadership, key stakeholders, and technical teams
* Project Management Execution Capabilities: Outstanding project management capabilities to oversee multiple initiatives concurrently while ensuring timely delivery and risk management
* Collaborative Leadership Ability: The ability to build and sustain relationships across diverse functions and geographies, influence stakeholders, and lead cross\-functional teams towards common goals
* Consultative Experience: Prior experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst or Functional Consultant, providing valuable insights into the user’s perspective and the functional intricacies of HC systems


 Interested candidates can apply through our website:
   

  

 https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/AscHHCJul25
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.
   

  

 The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
   

  

 Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

jobs.description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Data Management Analyst.

**In this role, you will:**

* Participate in less complex analysis to identify and remediate data quality or integrity issues and to identify and remediate process or control gaps
* Adhere to data governance standards and procedures
* Identify data quality metrics and execute data quality audits to benchmark the state of data quality
* Design and monitor data governance, data quality and metadata policies, standards, tools, processes, or procedures to ensure data control and remediation for companywide data management functions
* Support communications with basic documentation related to requirements, design decisions, issue closure, or remediation updates
* Support issue remediation by performing medium risk data profiling, data or business analysis, and data mapping as part of root cause or impact analysis
* Provide support to regulatory analysis and reporting requirements
* Recommend plans for the development and implementation of initiatives that assess the quality of new data sources
* Work with business and technology partners or subject matter professionals to document or maintain business or technical metadata about systems, business or data elements, or data\-related controls
* Consult with clients to assess the current state of data quality within area of assigned responsibility

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 2\+ years of Data Management, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Project Management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to work with senior leadership and OC\-level stakeholders
* Experience in BFSI or regulated industry environments is desirable
* Strong hold on data governance and data management functions
* Solid documentation, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in large enterprise environments with cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to independently manage tasks, priorities, and timelines.
* Strong presentation skills for leadership updates and governance reviews.
* Lead or participate in moderately complex programs and initiatives for data quality, governance, and metadata activities
* Design and conduct moderately complex analysis to identify and remediate data quality, data integrity, process, and control gaps
* Analyze, assess, and test data controls and data systems to ensure quality and risk compliance standards are met and adhere to data governance standards and procedures
* Identify data quality metrics and execute data quality audits to benchmark the state of data quality
* Develop recommendations for optimal approaches to resolve data quality issues and implement plans for assessing the quality of new data sources leveraging domain expertise and data, business, or process analysis to inform and support solution design
* Lead project teams and mentor less experienced staff members
* Drive planning and coordination on moderately complex remediation efforts acting as central point of contact
* Consult with clients to assess the current state of data and metadata quality within area of assigned responsibility
* Participate in cross\-functional groups to develop companywide data governance strategies
* Provide input into communication routines with stakeholders, business partners, and experienced leaders
* Lead Data Literacy program

**Job Expectations:**

* Actively work on complex enterprise\-wide programs and collaborates on strategic initiatives for data governance, data management and stakeholder engagement
* Manage and maintain Documentation to support Data Governance and management activities.
* Ability to drive executive reporting end\-to\-end with minimal supervision. • Demonstrated expertise in reporting and dashboard creation.
* Strong governance mindset with attention to detail. • Develop and manage executive dashboards, reports, and governance updates for OC and above.
* Prepare executive\-ready decks, briefing notes, and structured narratives reflecting data initiatives, risks, and progress.
* Translate complex data governance concepts into simplified content for senior leadership consumption.
* Present insights, risk summaries, and data management updates to leadership forums and governance committees
* Manage high\-visibility stakeholder interactions with Operational Committee members and senior executives.
* Coordinate cross\-functional governance discussions, decision\-making sessions, and communication workflows
* Act as a bridge between data governance teams, business leaders, and technology partners
* Develop clear, compelling visuals and narratives for senior leadership
* Shift timings 01:30 PM to 10:30 PM IST

**Posting End Date:**


15 Jun 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

jobs.title: Technical Lead & Manager
jobs.description:
**We are WisdomAI.**

*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*


WisdomAI builds AI\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.


We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.


The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both.


If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for our first Technical Lead \& Manager in India. This role will help shape the next chapter of that organization while remaining deeply involved in the technical work itself.

**How we work**
---------------

### **Hands\-On Leadership**


We don't see management and engineering as separate tracks.Our Technical lead will participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, hiring decisions, and occasionally jump into code themselves. The ideal balance is roughly 40% leadership and 60% technical contribution.

**Ownership**


Both the geographies \- India and US \- own meaningful parts of the product and platform. Engineers are trusted with end\-to\-end ownership and leaders are expected to create the environment where that ownership thrives.

### **Talent Density**


We're intentional about every hire.The team includes engineers from companies such as Google, Meta, Rubrik, Glean, and other world\-class organizations. Maintaining and raising that bar is one of the most important responsibilities of this role.

### **Product Thinking**


The best engineering decisions start with understanding the customer problem.We look for leaders who can connect technical choices to customer outcomes and help teams prioritize accordingly.

### **Builders**


We value people who can build from first principles.Processes, operating rhythms, performance management, career development, organizational design—none of these are finished products. You'll help create and evolve them as the organization grows.

**What you'd work on**
----------------------

### **Scaling a High\-Performance Engineering Organization**


The India team has grown rapidly and now spans backend systems, platform infrastructure, frontend experiences, and machine learning.


You'll help build the systems that allow that team to scale without losing speed, quality, or culture.

### **Developing Future Technical Leaders**


Many of our engineers are capable of becoming future staff engineers, tech leads, and engineering managers.


A significant part of this role is helping them get there through mentorship, coaching, feedback, and career development.

### **Raising the Hiring Bar**


We're actively growing.


You'll partner closely with leadership to identify exceptional talent, evaluate candidates, and ensure every hire improves the organization.

### **Driving Technical Excellence**


As the organization grows, maintaining a high technical bar becomes harder.


You'll help guide architecture discussions, participate in design reviews, review code, and ensure engineering quality scales alongside headcount.

### **Building the Next Generation of Analytics**


From agent orchestration and reasoning systems to distributed data infrastructure and AI\-powered user experiences, you'll work alongside the team solving technically ambitious problems at the intersection of AI, data, and enterprise software.

**You may be a good fit if you**
--------------------------------

* Have spent years building and shipping complex software systems
* Have managed engineers and genuinely enjoy helping people grow
* Still love engineering and want to remain technically involved
* Hold a high bar for technical quality and execution
* Operate with high ownership and low ego
* Can balance speed with sound engineering judgment
* Have strong product instincts and care about customer outcomes
* Want to help build an organization, not simply inherit one

**Strong candidates may also have**
-----------------------------------

* Experience at companies that have built at scale and have strong engineering cultures
* Startup or founding engineer experience
* Experience scaling engineering organizations from
* Experience with distributed systems, infrastructure, AI, data platforms, or developer tools
* Experience hiring and developing senior engineering talent

**Not sure this is the right fit?**
-----------------------------------

* Looking for a pure people\-management role with little technical involvement? This probably isn't it.
* Looking for a remote role? We work together in\-office five days a week.
* Looking primarily for title progression? We're more interested in builders than titles.

**Why WisdomAI?**
-----------------


You'll join a company founded by repeat entrepreneurs and early builders from companies including Rubrik and Glean.


We're tackling one of the largest software categories in the world: business intelligence and analytics.


We're backed by leading investors including Kleiner Perkins and NVIDIA Ventures.


Most importantly, you'll inherit a strong team and have the opportunity to shape what engineering leadership looks like in India from the ground up.

  

\-

**Our CRAFT**


CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.

**C — Customer trust.** Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.

**A — Authenticity.** We say the hard things, directly and …

jobs.description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


The Senior Product Manager is responsible for defining, delivering, and scaling core payment‑processing capabilities across global card‑present and card‑not‑present channels.


This role owns end‑to‑end product management for a defined set of payment platform capabilities, ensuring consistency, scalability, and alignment across gateways, processors, schemes, and downstream services. The Senior Manager partners closely with engineering, architecture, operations, risk, compliance, finance, and commercial teams to deliver high‑quality payment capabilities aligned with platform standards and regulatory requirements.


As a senior individual contributor, this role plays a key part in quarterly planning, roadmap execution, and cross‑team alignment within the Payment Processing Product Management organization and the broader Visa Acceptance Platform.

**Payments Domain Expertise**

* Strong working knowledge of payment acceptance, processing, and orchestration, including authorization, settlement, tokenization, network rules, and payment‑scheme behaviors
* Experience working with acquiring, gateway processing, issuer behaviors, and optionality across payment rails (card, wallets, A2A, alternative payments)
* Familiarity with fraud‑management concepts (e.g., 3DS, routing strategies) is highly desirable

**Product Strategy \& Roadmap Execution**

* Contribute to and execute product strategy for assigned payment platform capabilities, including capability design and scaling considerations
* Identify customer and market needs across merchants, PSPs, acquirers, and alternative payment methods
* Translate customer, partner, and regulatory inputs into a clear, actionable roadmap/epic/features for payment flows and platform enhancements

**Product Definition \& Delivery**

* Define detailed product requirements, epics, features, process flows, and business rules for complex payment capabilities
* Own cross‑functional readiness for assigned capabilities, including operational procedures, risk/compliance alignment, partner onboarding, and performance metrics
* Participate in agile ceremonies as needed to ensure shared understanding and delivery against product goals
* Ensure end‑to‑end payment experiences are well‑defined, including retries, fallbacks, routing logic, error handling, and user experience considerations

**Data‑Driven Decision Making**

* Partner with analytics and operations teams to define KPIs, dashboards, and monitoring tools that support prioritization and performance tracking
* Analyze trends such as authorization declines, fraud rates, routing effectiveness, and cost‑to‑serve to inform product improvements
* Commercialization \& Go‑to‑Market
* Support development of value propositions, pricing inputs, merchant‑facing narratives, and readiness materials
* Collaborate with sales, program management, finance, legal, compliance, UX, and partners to support go‑to‑market execution
* Participate in merchant and partner engagements by clearly articulating product capabilities, differentiation, and roadmap direction


This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

* 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 6 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
* Minimum of 5 years of product management experience in payment processing domain and API‑based products.
* Strong expertise in payments processing, including gateways, acquiring, scheme rules, lifecycle flows, and regulatory considerations
* Experience defining API contracts, platform capabilities, and contributing to longer‑term product architecture decisions
* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills, with a bias toward scalable, reusable product solutions

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:
**About Auric AI** 




 Auric AI is developing the world's most advanced AI\-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications
 



 Defense and military organizations today receive overwhelming volumes of visual data from satellites and drones. Processing this manually is slow, expensive, and error\-prone. Our mission is to use AI\-powered vision systems to detect and classify high\-value military objects such as tanks, artillery, radars, and missile launchers so analysts and commanders can act faster and with greater confidence.
 



  





 We’re a fast\-moving defense technology startup, combining world\-class AI research with real\-world military applications to create intelligence platforms that can make a difference where time and trust matter most.
 



**The Role** 




 We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the development of our Vision Intelligence Platform.
 



 This is not a traditional PM role. You will:
 


* Think from first principles to design workflows that make AI useful in mission\-critical contexts.
* Translate AI research into usable, analyst\-facing products.
* Balance speed, trust, and usability when making product decisions.
* Be AI\-native using the latest AI tools to build wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and demo flows at speed.
* You will own the end\-to\-end product experience: defining workflows, designing intuitive screens, prioritizing features, and ensuring analysts receive intelligence they can trust all within minutes of image arrival.



**What You’ll Do** 



* Vision \& Roadmap


1. Define the product vision and articulate a clear north star for the platform.
2. Build and communicate a roadmap balancing near\-term MVP delivery with long\-term platform growth.


* Workflow \& UX Design


1. Map the full analyst journey: image ingestion → preprocessing → AI detection → quality review → database → dissemination.
2. Work with engineers and designers to create intuitive, analyst\-ready screens.
3. Use AI\-powered tools (e.g., Figma plugins, AI prototyping, AI design assistants) to generate wireframes and demo flows rapidly.


* Feature Prioritization


1. Define MVP scope and ruthlessly separate must\-haves from nice\-to\-haves.
2. Make trade\-offs between speed\-to\-decision, detection accuracy, and user trust.


* Execution \& Delivery


1. Translate requirements into clear PRDs and product specs.
2. Drive collaboration between AI researchers, engineers, and domain experts.
3. Ensure reliability and quality in product releases.


* User \& Stakeholder Engagement


1. Engage with analysts, retired officers, and other stakeholders to understand workflows.
2. Synthesize fragmented feedback into coherent product direction.


* Metrics \& Success


1. Define and track success metrics: time\-to\-insight, adoption, accuracy, and trust in outputs.
2. Use feedback and data to iterate rapidly.



**What We’re Looking For** 



* AI\-native builder: highly proficient in using AI tools for prototyping, wireframing, and creating demo flows.
* First principles thinker who simplifies complex problems into clear workflows.
* Technical fluency: understand how AI and software systems work, even if you don’t code daily.
* User empathy: can design for non\-technical users working under pressure.
* Execution strength: bias for rapid prototyping, iteration, and delivery.
* Communication skills: able to align researchers, engineers, and defense users.
* Prior startup/founder experience or exposure to AI/ML products is a strong plus.



**Why Join Us** 



* Work on one of the hardest, most impactful problems in defense AI.
* Collaborate with a small, world\-class team of researchers and engineers.
* High ownership from day one shapes the platform, not just maintains it.
* Move fast, learn fast, we build, test, and iterate aggressively.
* Be part of a mission\-driven company where AI meets national security.



 Auric AI is building the future of defense intelligence. If you’re an AI\-native product builder who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment, we’d love to hear from you.

 Ship fast.

**Who we are** 






 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com
 




  
 




**Job summary** 






 We are seeking Principal Platform Product Manager to define and lead DigiCert's API platform as both an internal engineering standard and externally differentiated developer product. This is a dual access role: inbound, you are the Platform authority who sets API structure, governance, guardrails and developer experience standards that all DigiCert product teams build to. Outbound, you are the thought leader who shapes the developer portal, external API experience and MCP strategy that customers, partners and 3rd party developers depend on. The person in this role will simultaneously be the most demanding internal API standard setter and the most credible external advocate for what a best\-in\-class digital trust API platform can be.
 





 The Principal Platform Product Manager is responsible to understand market needs and trends, collaborate with product teams horizontally across the portfolio, manage the delivery and success of initiatives and supporting platform components in a data\-driven manner, and drive priorities that maximize platform value to both internal and external customers. The Principal Platform Product Manager will lead strategic and tactical activities for large, broad, and highly complex initiatives that impact all portfolio solutions, not limited to Platform. This is a critical, highly visible role charged with the strategy and driving the execution of priority initiatives at all levels across the organization. Individuals in this role will also mentor lower\-level contributors. This role has a seat on the Platform Product Management team. 
 




  
 




**What you will do** 





 The Principal API Platform Product Manager serves as the primary owner of our API Platform initiative, with substantial contribution and stakes in several other Platform initiatives. In support of this mission, this role will conduct internal and external research: customer requirements, market requirements, competitive research, internal research and analysis to inform strategic direction and priorities. They will establish a backlog of portfolio requirements that express dependencies on the Platform and actively maintain a prioritized stack\-ranking to inform their executable roadmap and regularly collaborate across the business to collect and socialize a comprehensive, accurate and detailed set of feature requirements for one or more major platform initiatives. As the thought leader for API Platform, this role is responsible for constructing both the internal and external visions and leading discussions with functional leadership across the organization to gain alignment.
 
  
 
 Primary responsibilities and Duties include:
 
  
 
 Outbound Elements:
 
* Own the collective API vision for Platform, including strategy, planning, and execution \- and share accountability for the outcome
* Serve as externally facing subject matter expert with customer, partner and developer audiences to gain deep understanding of their needs, represent strategy and roadmap, solicit participation in proof of concepts, beta releases, advisory counsels
* Serve as thought leader for API requirements at DigiCert: meet with analysts to discuss market dynamics and competitive positioning, publish articles/white papers, post relevant content to engage with their external stakeholder community
* Work closely with Finance to develop Pricing and Packaging strategies
* Work closely with Marketing to develop GTM strategy, messaging, positioning and supporting artifacts




 Inbound Elements: 
 



* Own and understand API\-specific platform requirements such as developer experience, webhook frameworks, API governance, security/compliance controls, automated documentation, version/change management; serve as subject matter expert for API requirements across functions to drive collaboration and achieve alignment on objectives, requirements, dependencies, design, and implementation
* Leads the decomposition of strategic objectives into phased operational and tactical goals and measures that translates into platform implications (e.g. APIs, metering, lifecycle management, reporting, portal), and work with the teams in each of these areas establish requirements, align on priorities, and choreograph delivery
* Lead the discussion to set business priorities that feed into the planning and execution of API Platform in close collaboration with other product teams and functions to ensure alignment with the needs of the business.
* Responsible and accountable for the technical vision, strategy, planning and execution \- and shares accountability for the outcome
* Work across all platform teams (e.g. Access Control, API, Common Services, Customer Experience) on roadmap planning cycles, backlog discovery and prioritization, pre\-development design and alignment, and operational execution
* Be responsible and accountable for API Platform acceptance and success criteria of every internal and external release
* Leads the buy/build assessment for platform components where appropriate, along with vendor assessment and proposal
* Owns the technical definition, prioritization and hygiene of product backlog(s) throughout the concept through delivery process
* Owns the execution and outcome by partnering closely with immediate platform core team (Engineering, Architecture \& UX) as well solutions core teams to represent business objectives along with support

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for
 **Product Managers!**
**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy and Vision: develop and execute a clear product vision and strategy aligned with overall business objectives. Conduct thorough market research to identify opportunities, customer needs, and competitive landscapes.
* Voice of the customer: understands, shape and address the different functions/regions needs, ensuring the business needs are well understood across D\&T and within the data product working group.
* Product Roadmap and Delivery: create and prioritize a product roadmap based on business value, customer feedback, and data\-driven insights. Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products on time and within budget.
* Value Creation and Measurement: define, measure, and optimize the value delivered by data products. Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and track product performance to inform continuous improvement.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: build strong partnerships with data science, engineering, and business teams to ensure alignment and efficient product development.
* Data Governance and Quality: champion data governance initiatives, ensuring data quality, security, and compliance with relevant regulations. Work closely with central governance team on co\-designing and implementing internal data policies.
* Product Launch and Scaling: develop and execute go\-live strategies to successfully launch data products. Drive product adoption and scalability across the organization.
* Data Literacy and Culture: promote data\-driven decision making and foster a data\-centric culture. Responsible for creating and maintenance of relevant documented within expected remit.
* Team Leadership: provide leadership and mentorship to agile teams, driving innovation and high performance.


**Qualifications**
* Data Analytics: proven expertise on data analysis and manipulation. The ability to interpret data and transform it into a meaningful story if vital.
* Desired: knowledge of statistical modelling and visualisation best practices, UX/UI.
* Data manipulation and transformation: proficiency in SQL is required.
* Desired: knowledge in Python/R applied to data analysis. Data management certifications (DAMA or others).
* Data architecture and modelling: intermediate knowledge of data architecture, modelling and data management principles is critical.
* Desired: database design, systems integrations best practices.
* Experience with ETL/ELT Processes: intermediate knowledge of data extraction, transformation and ingestion processes.
* Desired: best practices in complex system integrations and quality principles for data ingestion.
* Machine Learning and GenAI: basic understanding of ML models and familiarity with GenAI principles.
* Desired: previous experiences on those domains, with proven benefits/hands\-on.
* Agile principles: advanced knowledge in agile methods (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and tools (Azure DevOps) for product development.
* Desired: certifications on that area.
* Data governance and quality: advanced knowledge in data governance and quality assurance principles. Intermediate knowledge of privacy regulations (GDPR).
* Desired: certifications on that are.
* Cloud Platforms and Data Tools: good familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, as well as data tools like Tableau, Power BI, and Hadoop/Spark, is helpful for building and deploying data products.
* Desired: good understanding and/or certifications on Azure and Databricks.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Communication and Storytelling: solid experience on translating complex data point into clear, actionable messages.
* Strategic and Innovation thinking: intermediate experience with innovation methods applied to data strategic execution and strong understanding of data products aligned to business objectives.
* Collaboration and Influence: strong interpersonal skills are essential for working with cross\-functional teams, influencing stakeholders, and rallying support for product initiatives.
* Problem\-Solving and Analytical Thinking: advanced ability to break down complex problems into actionable steps to solve business challenges.
* Customer empathy: strong ability to understand other's situations and levels of understanding. The ability to visualise stakeholder needs and translate this to impactful data products is critical.
* Adaptability and Resilience: need to remain agile and open to received and process feedback, adjusting attitudes, processes, and products to changes in technology, business needs, and market trends.
* Project Management: organizational skills, including time management, team management (directly and/or indirectly) and task prioritization, are crucial for managing the demands of product development.
* Leadership and mentorship: inspiring and guiding both technical and non\-technical team members, often without direct authority, is key to fostering a high\-performance, collaborative environment.

Relevant candidates will be contacted via email and asked to fill in additional details as part of the next stage of the application process.)

jobs.title: Scrum Master
jobs.description:
**IT Scrum Master – Data \& AI Solutions CoE**
----------------------------------------------

### **PURPOSE AND SCOPE**


The IT Scrum Master in the Data \& AI Solutions CoE provides delivery leadership and Agile coaching to one or more data, analytics, and AI\-focused technology teams. This role enables the successful execution of data\-driven initiatives that support the organization’s business strategy and digital transformation objectives.


The Scrum Master ensures teams adhere to Agile and Scrum practices while delivering high\-quality data and AI products, including analytics platforms, machine learning models, and data pipelines. The role is responsible for maintaining predictable delivery, managing dependencies, and ensuring alignment to scope, timelines, and quality expectations within data and AI programs.


The Scrum Master monitors team progress, promotes transparency across data initiatives, facilitates risk management, and ensures effective communication and escalation within the Data \& AI CoE and broader stakeholder community.

### **PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as Scrum Master for Data \& AI Agile teams, providing leadership, facilitation, and coaching to ensure successful delivery of data products and AI solutions.
* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, tailored to data and analytics workflows.
* Coach teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum practices, and continuous improvement within a data\-driven and AI\-centric environment.
* Partner with Product Owners, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers to support backlog prioritization, refinement, and clarity of user stories, including data requirements, model objectives, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify, track, and proactively remove impediments related to data dependencies, data quality issues, infrastructure constraints, and model lifecycle challenges.
* Promote transparency by tracking and communicating Agile metrics such as velocity, model delivery cycles, data pipeline readiness, and sprint progress.
* Support Agile planning and execution while ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance, AI standards, and delivery frameworks.
* Establish and maintain effective communication plans, ensuring timely updates to stakeholders on data initiatives, analytics outcomes, and AI model progress.
* Facilitate cross\-team collaboration across data engineering, data science, analytics, and platform teams to manage dependencies and shared risks.
* Contribute to the development and adoption of Agile best practices specifically tailored for Data \& AI delivery within the CoE.
* Apply sound judgment to resolve complex delivery challenges involving data integration, model development, and analytical workflows.
* Mentor and support less\-experienced Scrum Masters or team members within the Data \& AI CoE.
* Escalate risks, impediments, or delivery concerns related to data availability, model performance, or platform constraints to leadership when necessary.
* Ensure compliance with the Code of Business Conduct, data governance policies, AI ethics guidelines, and all applicable company procedures and regulations.
* Assist with additional Data \& AI initiatives and CoE\-related duties as assigned.

### **EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s Degree required; Advanced Degree (Data Science, Analytics, AI, or related field) will be an added advantage .
* 5–8 years of related IT experience, including hands\-on experience supporting Agile teams in data, analytics, or AI/ML environments.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or equivalent Agile certification required or strongly preferred.
* Proven knowledge of Agile frameworks, Scrum practices, and SDLC methodologies, with exposure to DataOps, MLOps, or Analytics delivery models preferred.
* Experience working within a Data \& AI Center of Excellence, analytics practice, or enterprise data platform environment.
* Familiarity with data engineering concepts, machine learning lifecycle, analytics platforms, and cloud data ecosystems is highly desirable.
* Strong organizational and facilitation skills with the ability to manage multiple data initiatives and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work creatively, analytically, and independently in a fast\-paced, data\-driven problem\-solving environment.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across data engineers, data scientists, business stakeholders, and leadership teams.
* Effective conflict resolution and problem\-solving capabilities, especially in complex data environments.
* Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills.
* Ability to drive Agile maturity and sustain change within Data \& AI transformation initiatives.
* Strong business acumen; understanding of how data and AI drive business value is preferred.
* Experience in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, financial services) and familiarity with data compliance standards is a plus.

jobs.title: Sr UX Researcher
jobs.description:
**About Us**  

Target is one of the world’s most recognized brands and one of the leading retailers of America. Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands, is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Marketing organization. Target Marketing, is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights, and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our business objectives, guest segments and behaviors, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Our commitment to partnering both internally and with external agencies gives us a wide range of capabilities, from award\-winning creative work to exciting and unique promotional marketing. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target. We believe in providing seamless and easy shopping experiences to our guests, on both online and offline touch points, by designing the best experiences through a user centered design approach.

 **Job Description**  

The UX Research Team is responsible for building empathy for the Target Guest and Target Team Member throughout the product development lifecycle for Target’s digital products, inclusive of web experience, app experience, internal tools, and in\-store digital tools. The Senior UX researcher is a key partner to several functions in the digital group including product owners, UX designers, engineers, data scientists, and site merchandisers.  

Research projects span from lean usability validation (as needed by the product teams) to strategic future\-thinking discovery projects (driven by researchers’ insights) to enable constant experience optimization and inform strategic business priorities.  

Using both qualitative and quantitative methods, the Senior UX Researcher will translate research insights into powerful stories that not only help shape product design and development but also influence the world of modern retail.

 **Core Responsibilities**  

* Supports the Principal Researcher(s) with research requests, from scoping initiatives, coordinating testing needs and synthesizing findings.
* Supports product teams throughout the research project life cycle – recommending appropriate methodology, scoping, and coordinating the entire process, facilitating in\-field research and post\-research synthesis through analysis.
* Conducts and synthesises qualitative and quantitative research projects – including, but not limited to: in person moderated testing, remote moderated \& unmoderated testing, surveys, heuristic reviews, benchmark studies, concept testing, online \& in\-store intercepts, ethnographies, shopalongs.
* Assists the broader team in keeping our ongoing research library up\-to\-date and comprehensive.
 **Required Qualifications**:  

* Genuine curiosity about people and experiences.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex concepts to cross functional partners
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* A strong ability to tell compelling stories from data.
* Comfortable within ambiguity with the ability to prioritize; demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects (both small and large) and adjust to changing priorities
* Strong project management skills – experience managing multiple projects at various stages in the project life cycle.
* Proficient in Powerpoint, Outlook, Word and other MS Office software.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience practicing UX design research for digital product teams or 4 years of relevant consumer research experience.
* Comfortable speaking to a diverse group of people and leading conversations to discover research insights.
 **Preferred Skills**  

* 7\+ years of work experience and preferred a full time degree in Anthropology, Social Science, Design Research, Psychology, Human Factors, HCI, or related field.
* Experience in Lean UX Research methods, including remote moderated \& unmoderated testing, online \& in\-context (store) intercepts.
* Experience and understanding of retail – both store and online.
* Demonstrated understanding of accessibility user testing using assistive technologies.
* Experience with video editing software.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Product Management
jobs.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

ABOUT JLL TECHNOLOGIES
  
JLL Technologies (JLLT) is the technology and data science engine of JLL, one of the world's leading commercial real estate services firms. JLLT builds intelligent, connected, and sustainable workplace solutions powered by proprietary platforms, data products, and AI. The Workplace Management (WPM) Transformation Program is redefining how JLL and its clients operate facilities — embedding real\-time insights and AI\-powered automation into day\-to\-day workplace operations.
  
THE ROLE
  
We need a product manager who builds things. Not someone who writes strategy decks and hands them over — someone who opens a laptop, fires up a model, strings together an agent, and ships something by end of day. This Director of Product Management role owns the product for Workplace OS, JLL's next\-generation workplace management platform, and will be measured by what gets built and whether it works.
  
  

You will define features, write specs, experiment with AI tools, prototype workflows, and work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with engineers and designers to turn ideas into product. You are energized by the pace of AI development and have a habit of testing new models, frameworks, and tools before anyone tells you to. You hold strong opinions about what makes a great product experience but know that the right answer often comes from trying things — not from more meetings.
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
Ship Product
  
Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for core Workplace OS capabilities — from discovery through launch and iteration.
  
Write clear, detailed product specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can actually build from, including edge cases, error states, and AI output handling.
  
Sit in engineering standups, participate in sprint reviews, and stay close enough to the code to catch problems before they ship.
  
**Manage the backlog with discipline:** prioritize ruthlessly, cut scope when necessary, and keep the team focused on what matters most.
  
Experiment Aggressively with AI
  
Prototype new AI\-powered features yourself — using tools like Claude, GPT\-4o, Cursor, or whatever the current best tool is for the job.
  
Test and evaluate LLMs, agentic frameworks, and automation tools to inform build vs. buy decisions with real evidence.
  
Design and iterate on agentic workflows for workplace operations: safety conversations, compliance tracking, participation nudging, facilities incident routing.
  
Define the human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths, confidence thresholds, and guardrails that make AI features safe to put in front of real users.
  
Stay current on the AI landscape — not as a hobby, but as a professional obligation. You should know what shipped last week and whether it matters for what we're building.
  
Drive Clarity from Ambiguity
  
Translate fuzzy business problems and operational pain points into precise product requirements and testable hypotheses.
  
Work directly with Facilities Managers, Account Directors, and HSSE leads to understand what actually breaks in the field — and design for it.
  
Define success metrics for every feature before it ships, and own the post\-launch review to determine whether the feature worked.
  
Identify open questions early, flag them loudly, and drive to resolution rather than letting them become blockers mid\-sprint.
  
Collaborate Across the Stack
  
Partner with engineering leads, data scientists, and ML engineers as a peer — not a client. Understand the technical constraints and work within them creatively.
  
Work with design to produce experiences that are simple enough for a Facility Manager to use on their phone between walkthroughs.
  
Coordinate with implementation and customer success to ensure features land well in the field, not just in the demo.
  
Communicate clearly up to VP and executive stakeholders — turn technical progress into business narrative without losing the substance.
  
WHAT YOU BRING
  
Required
  
7\+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in enterprise SaaS, platform products, or operational technology.
  
A genuine, demonstrable hands\-on relationship with AI tools — you have built things using LLMs, agents, or AI\-powered automation in the last 12 months.
  
**Technical fluency:** you can read an API spec, understand a data schema, review a system design, and have a substantive conversation with an engineer about why something is hard.
  
A track record of shipping product in complex organizations — navigating ambiguity, managing stakeholders, and keeping a team moving.
  
**Strong written communication:** specs, PRDs, executive updates, and user\-facing copy should all be in your range.
  
Comfort with fast iteration — you prefer small bets and rapid feedback loops over long planning cycles.
  
Preferred
  
Hands\-on experience with agentic AI frameworks or MCP server integrations.
  
**Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem:** Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Azure AD.
  
Background in workplace technology, facilities management, IoT, or building operations.
  
Experience designing AI features for regulated or safety\-sensitive environments, including audit trails, explainability requirements, and escalation logic.
